title: Threads Continuation Judgement
description: Canonical machine-readable output contract for Threads Phase 7 semantic continuation/root-only classifiers. Acceptance thresholds and evidence-dependent gates remain in trusted validation code.

selected_shortcodes.description: Ordered continuation candidate identities selected as part of the original article body.

root_only.description: True only when the root itself is judged to be the complete original body and no continuation candidate is selected.

complete.description: Whether the semantic classifier considers its proposed body reconstruction complete. Trusted code still applies deterministic acceptance gates.

rationale.description: Short explanation of the semantic judgement.

candidate_labels.description: Per-candidate semantic classifications. Evidence coverage requirements are enforced by trusted validation code where applicable.
